[SWS_CM_00231] Behavior of a ServiceProxy over a secure channel using a
reliable transport protocol before the secure channel is established
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00804
⌈
If a secure channel is configured for a
ServiceProxy
, futures returned by the
Ser-
viceProxy
’s methods shall only be satisfied after the configured secure channel was
successfully established, or if the secure channel could not be established. These
include:
• the function call operator (
operator()
) of the respective
Method
class (see
